---
title: "Phase 3. Analysis"
description: "Do the work to the approved design, check it as you go, and have it reviewed."
---

You carry out the analysis following the design and plan, and the checking happens throughout
rather than at the end.

## What you do

1. **Do the analysis to the approved design and plan.** Record any
   departure from the plan as you make it.
2. **Do your own verification and validation first.** Verification asks whether the analysis was
   carried out properly. Validation asks whether it was the right kind of analysis at all. Both
   run throughout, proportionate to the work.
3. **Keep a quality assurance log** of what you checked, when, and what you found.
4. **Hand it to your critical friend**, who runs the checks the level asks for and reports back.
   Their findings are yours to act on.
5. **Log decisions and assumption changes as you make them**, not afterwards.

## Records to keep

Proportionate to the work, version controlled, securely stored and retrievable:
the specification and design, notes of any deviation from the plan, a log of data and assumptions,
an outline of the assurance activities, technical documentation, and lessons as they arise.

Where your analysis involves code, the
[NHSBSA Analytical Code Assurance Playbook](https://nhsbsa-data-analytics.github.io/nhsbsa-analytical-code-assurance-playbook)
covers version control, testing, peer review and documentation.

## What you leave behind

- The quality assurance log: what was checked, when, and what was found.
- The decision log, including anything that changed and why.
- Your critical friend's findings, and what you did about each one.
- Technical documentation enough for somebody to re-run the work.

## Ready for Phase 4 when

- The checks the level asks for have been done, by you and by your critical friend.
- Their findings have been acted on, or answered.
- The log says what was checked rather than what was planned.

## Who does what in this phase

| Role | In Phase 3 |
|---|---|
| **Analyst** | Do the work and your own checks first. Log decisions and assumption changes as you make them |
| **Critical friend** | Run the checks the level asks for. Report errors and improvements back |
| **Commissioner** | Stay available. Review any change of design or method. Resist changing the question late |
| **Analysis Senior Responsible Officer** | Business Critical work only. Stay aware of progress, and be available to approve at delivery |
